title: Grateful Dead Live at UI Field House, University Of Iowa on 1973-02-24
venue: UI Field House, University Of Iowa
source: partial source: aud cassette master; taped by Mark Owen; sears & robuck deck, floor, 100’ from stage; nakamichi dragon > benchmark adc1 @ 24/96> adobe audition cc > fission > xACT flac 16/44.1; transferred by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: Poor‑quality audience tape captures an off‑the‑charts show highlighted by a spooky Truckin jam and a confidently sung Wave That Flag.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as “off the charts” with standout moments in the Truckin jam and a tight, confident rendition of Wave That Flag. However, listeners note that the audience recording is subpar, only partly rescued by a brief soundboard snippet that sounds great but feels jarring when spliced in.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews praise the musical performance (high energy, standout jams) but consistently criticize the recording quality, leading to a solid but not outstanding combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall poor audience tape; a soundboard snippet is praised for clarity but feels jarring when integrated, making the recording uneven.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Shows strong momentum with a heavy Phil‑centered jam and spooky improvisation leading into Wave That Flag, though the exact set order isn’t detailed.

band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for a heavy February ’73 style jam; his bass work is noted as a key element of the performance.
